name: Dangers of the Windfury
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, adventurer. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done well, adventurer. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
